name: MAF bZIP transcription factor A
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: MAFA encodes transcription factor MafA. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.
